blurb: Guests sail aboard a classic American-made Hinckley Bermuda 40 sailboat. The experience typically lasts about three hours and includes ice, water, sodas, and set-ups provided by the captain. Guests may bring their own snacks and beverages and can participate in steering and sail handling under supervision.
extraNote: Most guests leave a tip at their discretion for the first mate · Slip E-9 in Biloxi Small Craft Harbor, just east of the Hard Rock and Beau Rivage Casinos.
